[RARC.8.5.1] An engine processes every observable event serially, inside its
consumption loop ([RARC.5.6.9]). Any parallelism in a deployment lives in
integrator code: sibling engines on different threads, or integrator-side I/O
fan-out. Sibling engines are independent streams, and ordering across them is
the integrator's to define when it bridges them.
